IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Local Government & Housing.

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that first-year taxes paid on new farm structures be used to offset any permit and inspection fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permit and inspection fees for new farmstructures; amending RCW 19.27.100; adding a new section to chapter19.27 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.40 RCW; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that Oregon doesnot charge any fees for their farm structures and there is a need forfarmers in Washington to have competitive parity with our neighboringstate. (2) In some instances, local governments are charging more for thepermit fee than it takes to buy the materials and construction of farmstructures, like a pole barn. Local governments benefit from theimprovements by having a new source of property tax revenue by thecreation of the new structure that generates revenues for many years. (3) The legislature intends that firstyear taxes paid on the newfarm structure be used to offset any permit and inspection fees thecounty planning department would charge.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Counties may not impose permit fees or inspection charges forthe construction or remodel of agricultural structures. (2) For purposes of this section and section 3 of this act,"agricultural structure" means a structure designed and constructed tohouse farm implements, hay, grain, poultry, livestock, or otherhorticultural products. This structure may not be: (a) A place of human habitation; (b) A place of employment where agricultural products areprocessed, treated, or packaged; (c) A place used by the public; (d) A climate controlled building; or (e) A structure used for purposes other than growing plants inwhich ten or more persons are present at any one time.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.27.100 and 1975 1st ex.s. c 8 s 1 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except as provided in section 2 of this act, nothing in thischapter shall prohibit a city, town, or county of the state fromimposing fees different from those set forth in the state buildingcode.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An amount equal to any reduction in revenue resulting from theagricultural structure permit fee and inspection charge exemptionsspecified in section 2 of this act must be allocated from the countygeneral levy imposed on the agricultural structure to the countyplanning department.
